proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I sent the parcel number and a few phone photos. Before anyone came out I had a printout showing 3.2 acres of palmetto, 0.8 of oak hammock, and a price for each. The final bill matched it to the dollar.
reviews.name: Marguerite O.

reviews.text: Our back paddock had gone to dog fennel and sweetgum shoots. Yolanda's crew mulched it, and they told me straight that it would need one more mowing pass in spring. It did, and now the mares are out there.
reviews.name: Hollis D.

reviews.text: Two big live oak limbs came down across the drive after the storm. They were out two days later and had it cut, chipped and passable by lunch.
reviews.name: Priscilla N.

reviews.text: The cogongrass along our south fence was spreading every year. They cleared it, marked the patches on a map of the property, and came back in eight weeks to check for regrowth.
reviews.name: Dwayne S.

reviews.text: Clear numbers, no surprises. They used a smaller tracked machine because our lot is soft sand near the river, and explained why before starting.
reviews.name: Ingeborg V.

reviews.text: We wanted riding trails through ten acres of oak scrub without losing the shade. They walked it with flags and cut exactly where we pointed, with nice wide turns for the horses.
reviews.name: Carmen T.

reviews.text: Forty-one stumps on an old pine plantation lot. They counted them on the walk-through, quoted per stump, and that's what we paid.
reviews.name: Leon J.

proof.guarantee: If the cleared ground measures smaller than the acreage we quoted, you pay only for what we measured.
